caption: The drawing depicts a single bed with a canopy on the left side. The bed frame is rectangular and appears to be made of wood, supported by four legs—two of which are visible, with the left leg being ornamented with carved grooves. A mattress or bedcover is shown on the bed, with a curved edge near the headboard. The headboard is partially visible on the right side, featuring a dark, semicircular top and two vertical posts with rounded finials. The canopy extends horizontally above the bed, supported by a vertical post at the top left corner. The canopy structure includes a horizontal beam with two parallel light-colored bands, and decorative woodwork on the underside, which includes scrolling, leaf-like patterns. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, using various shades of gray and black to depict depth and shadow, with no other objects present in the composition. The background is plain and unadorned, with the bed occupying the central horizontal space.
title: Half-canopy Carved Bed
